name: Apple Meringue Pudding
description: Historical recipe from The Canadian Family Cook Book (1914). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: eggs, whites and yolks beaten separately
ingredients.originalText: 3 eggs, whites and yolks beaten separately

instructions.text: Prepare the apples as for a pie, and stew till almost a pulp
While hot stir in the yolks of the eggs gradually
Pour into a buttered dish and bake for ten minutes
Cover, without drawing it from the oven, with a meringue made of the beaten whites, two tablespoonfuls of white sugar, and the almond flavoring
Spread it over with a tablespoon, evenly and quickly
Close the oven again and brown very slightly
Serve either hot or cold, as preferred

source.author: Grace E. Denison
source.originalInstructions:
1. Prepare the apples as for a pie, and stew till almost a pulp
2. Sweeten and spice
3. While hot stir in the yolks of the eggs gradually
4. Beat very light
5. Pour into a buttered dish and bake for ten minutes
6. Cover, without drawing it from the oven, with a meringue made of the beaten whites, two tablespoonfuls of white sugar, and the almond flavoring
7. Spread it over with a tablespoon, evenly and quickly
8. Close the oven again and brown very slightly
9. Serve either hot or cold, as preferred
